---
title: TableForm
env:
  - Wolfram Kernel
---

```wolfram
TableForm[table_List, opts___]
```
shows the given `table` (list) in a traditional form using [Grid](../Formatting/Grid) decoration

<Callout type="info">
For large formatted table, please see  [TableView](../GUI/TableView). It supports lazy loading and is much faster
</Callout>

## Options
### `TableAlignments`
Specifies the horizontal alignment of the columns.

### `TableHeadings`
Adds headings to the rows and columns of the table. Use `{rowHeadings, columnHeadings}`.

### `TableSpacing`
Specifies the spacing between rows and columns. A pair gives the horizontal and vertical spacing.

## Modifiers
See [Item](../Formatting/Item)

## Examples

<Callout>Tables are editable</Callout>

A fully formatted table 

```wolfram
TableForm[{{5, Item[7, Background->Yellow]}, {4, 2}, {10, 3}}, 
 TableHeadings -> {{"Group A", "Group B", "Group C"}, {"y1", "y2"}}]
```
